description: An unsigned transaction to sweep the USDG waiting at a receiving address into bUSDG for its owner now (making the address too, if it is not made yet). Borro's keeper sweeps on its own (about every five minutes once 1 USDG waits); this is for sooner. Any wallet may send it; the shares go to the owner. owner defaults to wallet. Simulated from the wallet; nothing is sent.

owner.description: Optional: the owner whose address to sweep (0x...), when it is not the sending wallet

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: payto_sweep
title: Prepare: sweep a receiving address into bUSDG now
